description: This PHP source file defines the CopyProjectActivityAPI class within the OrangeHRM system. The class provides API endpoints for listing activities that can be copied between two projects and for copying selected activities from one project to another. It handles validation, request processing, and interaction with the project service for these operations.

classes.name: CopyProjectActivityAPI
classes.description: API class for copying project activities between two projects, including listing copyable activities and executing the copy operation. It extends Endpoint and implements CollectionEndpoint, using traits and methods for validation, project service interactions, and request handling.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list copyable activities between two projects, including fetching activities, duplicated activities, and counts, then returning the data as a collection result.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to copy specified activities from one project to another, performing validation and invoking project service methods, returning the list of copied activity IDs.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented; throws a not authorized exception.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the GET request, including sorting and pagination rules.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the POST request, especially validating the activity IDs array.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Not implemented; throws a not authorized exception.

methods.name: getCommonURLValidationRules
methods.description: Provides shared validation rules for URL parameters: toProjectId and fromProjectId.

methods.name: getUrlAttributes
methods.description: Extracts the toProjectId and fromProjectId from request URL attributes.
